## Overview

A basic introduction to the command line. We work on some Linux basics that you
will need when you start working on any cluster — whether it's Dardel at PDC,
HPC2N in Umeå, a departmental cluster, or any online server. We cover all of the
basics, from what the command line is, to navigating it, making and editing
files, and a whole bunch of other nifty tricks.

This session is geared towards everyone who has never used the command line
before, and towards anyone who'd like to refresh their memory.

## Prerequisites

You are welcome to just come and listen. If you'd like to practice along and you
don't have access to a server or a Linux operating system, please download
[MobaXterm](https://mobaxterm.mobatek.net/download.html) beforehand. Mac users
can use the built-in Terminal.
